seo.description: Saint Anthony of Padua Parish in Dois Vizinhos, Brazil: Mass times, sacraments, communities, ministries and the story of our patron saint.

hero.lead: A community of faith that celebrates, welcomes and serves. Here you'll find Mass times, the sacraments and the way to become part of it.

quickActions.title: Everything you need, one tap away.
quickActions.lead: The most requested topics at the parish office, organized so you can sort them out quickly on your phone.

patron.title: Saint Anthony of Padua, the saint of the whole world.
patron.lead: Tireless preacher, Doctor of the Church and friend of the poor. He arrived in Dois Vizinhos with the first settlers and still gives our parish its name and soul.
patron.quote: Let words cease, and let deeds speak.
patron.imageAlt: Painting of Saint Anthony of Padua kneeling in a Franciscan habit, looking up at the Child Jesus appearing in the light

weekly.eyebrow: A week at the main church
weekly.title: Mass times
weekly.lead: Regular celebrations at the main church. On holidays and feast days times may change — follow the announcements.

community.title: One parish made of many communities.
community.lead: From the countryside to the city neighborhoods, each community welcomed its patron saint and keeps the faith alive. Our ministries and movements carry that faith into everyday life.
